content.definition: Legal obligation to remove/restore asset at end of useful life (environmental cleanup, removal costs)
content.when_recognized: When legal obligation exists (contractual, statutory, or constructive obligation)

initial_recognition.measure_at_pv: Present value of estimated future retirement costs
initial_recognition.capitalize: Add PV of obligation to asset's cost
initial_recognition.entry: DR Asset (or ARO Asset), CR Asset Retirement Obligation Liability

subsequent_measurement.accretion_expense: Increase liability over time using interest method (unwind discount)
subsequent_measurement.entry_each_period: DR Accretion Expense (IS), CR ARO Liability
subsequent_measurement.depreciation: Depreciate ARO asset over useful life (along with main asset)

calculation_example.facts: Oil rig costs $1M. Must be removed at end of 10-year life. Estimated removal cost $200K. Discount rate 6%.
calculation_example.initial_entry: DR Oil Rig $111,700, CR ARO Liability $111,700 (Total rig cost $1,111,700)

year_1.entry: DR Accretion Expense $6,702, CR ARO Liability $6,702 (Liability now $118,402)
year_1.depreciation: $1,111,700 / 10 = $111,170. DR Depreciation Expense $111,170, CR Accumulated Depreciation $111,170

changes_in_estimates.decreased_costs: Decrease asset (limited to carrying amount) and liability
changes_in_estimates.timing_changes: Adjust discount (change in interest rate affects PV)

actual_retirement.if_costs_equal_liability: DR ARO Liability, CR Cash (no gain/loss)
actual_retirement.if_costs_differ: Recognize gain (costs < liability) or loss (costs > liability)
actual_retirement.example: Liability $200K. Actual costs $210K. DR ARO Liability $200K, DR Loss $10K, CR Cash $210K

conditional_aro.definition: Obligation dependent on future event (timing uncertain)
conditional_aro.recognition: Recognize if probability-weighted estimate can be reasonably estimated
conditional_aro.example: Building with asbestos. Obligation to remove IF building demolished. Recognize if can estimate probability and costs.

disclosure_requirements: Reconciliation of beginning and ending liability (additions, accretion, settlements, revisions)
cpa_exam_tips: ARO recognized at PV of estimated future costs
Capitalize PV to asset (increases asset cost)
Each period: Accretion expense increases liability (interest on liability)
Depreciate ARO asset over useful life of main asset
Accretion expense = Beginning liability × Discount rate
Final liability should equal estimated retirement cost

initial_calculation: 2. Discount to PV using credit-adjusted rate
subsequent_periods: 2. DR Accretion Expense, CR ARO Liability
3. Depreciate ARO asset: Total asset cost / Useful life
common_mistakes: Not capitalizing ARO to asset (should increase asset cost)
Forgetting accretion expense (liability grows over time)
Using straight-line to increase liability (should use interest method)
Not depreciating ARO asset (should depreciate like main asset)

key_points: ARO: Legal obligation to remove/restore asset at end of life
Initial: Capitalize PV of retirement cost to asset, recognize liability
Each period: Accretion expense (unwind discount), depreciate ARO asset
Final liability equals estimated retirement cost
Changes in estimates: Adjust asset and liability prospectively
